chunks.text:
Product Profile
CR Dhan 310 is the first high protein rice variety in India, released by NRRI, Cuttack for the states of Odisha, Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. It has medium duration (120-125 days), with medium slender and good grain quality. This variety comes highly recommended for cultivation in irrigated areas as well as favorable shallow rainfed regions. On a national average, CR Dhan 310 achieves an average grain yield of 4.5 tons per hectare, and its polished rice contains an average protein content of 10.2%.
